title: Luxuriant Crunchy Ethiopian Lentil Stew
description: A nutty and crunchy Ethiopian dish featuring grapefruit juice and kombu-cold-extract, made in a traditional molcajete vessel, this stew is a low-glycemic-friendly indulgence. It combines the flavors of Ethiopia with a twist of citrus and seaweed.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large molcajete over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red lentils, grapefruit juice, kombu-cold-extract, berbere spice, and salt, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stew to the desired consistency.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with pepitas.
Offer injera bread on the side, if desired.
